items.text: a change of scene really morphs now. The colors cross over instead of jumping: the lines, the second color, touch, arrows, the pattern, and the ground (the stage and the trails follow it every frame), all in OKLab, so a dark ground warms through its own tones into terracotta

the field morphs too: the old current blends into the new one, so the particles drift from one into the next; the lens dips to nothing and comes back if it changes mode; lines, arrows and the pattern fade out and in
Morph is a row of beads like Every: Cut · 2 · 4 · 8 · 16 · 30 · 60 seconds, 8 by default. Cut is the instant change. The bead timing a morph wears a ring that fills to its end
a scene with its own morph says so at the Morph row's right ("this scene: 2 s"); without one, the row's choice is used. Snap, glide and slow come across as Cut, 2 and 8
a lit button is light again: the accent lifted toward white, a thick accent edge, a dark icon; the Sound button's level wave is white
the off thermometer is one piece: the same light blue fill, one thick accent edge round the bulb and up the neck (the button's thin grey rim steps aside while it runs)
on the lit Sound button the level wave is drawn in the ink (white on dark, black on light), so it stands apart from the accent edge and icon
the off thermometer's outline is the Sound button's own grey rim, carried up the neck; the rim stays visible through the whole drain and fade
the sound's off thermometer is frosted like the lit button it grows from: an accent wash on dark glass with an accent outline and icon, so neck and button match

a lit button on the bar (robot, dice, sound, tools) keeps the frosted glass, warmed with the accent, with an accent edge and icon, so it matches the drawers and shelf it opens; the dice's amount ring is accent again

turning the sound off is a thermometer that grows up out of the Sound button, filled in the button's own colour. The pill drains first while the sound stays full; when the level reaches the button, its fill shrinks and the sound fades with it. Touch any part of it, pill or button, to bring the sound back: it refills and sinks back into the button

the studio's library in Instruments: the glass and textures (Fracture's voices, written as recipes) and a drum kit that arrives as a groove (kick on the beat, snare on 2 and 4, hats on eighths, the rest ready to switch on)

Instruments opens Fracture sets too: each glass voice the set has on plays here, at its level. Save as a set writes your instruments in the same format, so Fracture and Pullula can open it and keep what they don't use
2 and 4, a backbeat, for sounds on the beat

Instruments (Pro, open in beta). Bring in sounds made in Pullula: a sound, a mix, saved mixes or a pack. Each one plays by touch (tap to strike, hold to sustain), on the beat, as a bed under everything, or from the pattern, where the drawing becomes the sequencer. Choose when you import it and change it any time. In the sound shelf: instruments
the sparkle on new buttons is calm now: half the size, beside the button instead of on it, with softly rounded points. It pulses twice when it appears and then holds still
a sparkle now lasts until eight newer features have arrived, not two releases. Pro features in beta keep their open padlock instead, and get no sparkle
